title: AnaDefAI
tagline: An AI analytics agent built with Coinbase AgentKit that uses Covalent data to provide natural language analysis of blockchain activity, with seamless Base network integration.
description:
This project creates an intelligent AI agent for blockchain analytics that makes on-chain data accessible through natural language interactions. Built on Coinbase's AgentKit framework, the agent combines multiple data sources:

Token balances and wallet analysis using Covalent's API
Protocol-specific metrics via The Graph
Base network integration through AgentKit
Natural language processing for user-friendly analytics

Key features:

Seamless AgentKit-powered interactions
Comprehensive wallet activity analysis
Multi-chain data integration
DeFi protocol metrics
Deployment on Base network
how_its_made:
The project leverages multiple partner technologies to create a powerful analytics solution:

Coinbase AgentKit as the core agent framework
Covalent's SDK for comprehensive blockchain data
TypeScript/Node.js implementation
Deployed on Base network for optimal performance

The agent uses AgentKit's conversation handlers to process natural language queries, coordinates with Covalent API for data retrieval, and returns structured analytics in a user-friendly format.
